verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is API-first, with docs stating partners can 'launch quickly with pre-built UI Flows, build custom experiences using APIs, or combine multiple approaches' (gusto-docs-38), and detailed API endpoints exist for payroll, contractors, time off, and onboarding, suggesting substantial API/UI parity. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming that every capability available through Gusto's pre-built UI Flows (e.g., approval interfaces, 401k enrollment links) is also fully replicable via raw API calls without using the Flow components. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or comprehensive endpoint mapping covering all UI Flow functionality, independent/hands-on confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
